statement: ∀ x y : GP.Space (n+1), dist x y ^ 2 = dist (GP.horizontal x) (GP.horizontal y) ^ 2 + dist (GP.vertical x) (GP.vertical y) ^ 2

simp only [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, GP.horizontal, GP.vertical]
rfl
